title: MalAvi Table of References record
description: Bibliographic entry cited across the database. Six columns are authoritative as of malaviR release 2026-03-23; DOI is an optional forward-looking column MalAvi does not yet populate (added by the curation pipeline for new papers, back-fillable for old ones).

REFERENCE_NAME.description: Citation key (e.g. 'Bensch et al 2009'). Joins to host/vector/morpho tables.

DOI.description: Digital Object Identifier (bare, e.g. '10.1111/mec.12345'), if known. Optional and not in the bundled malaviR release; captured going forward from the curation pipeline (submission.reference.doi) and usable as an exact de-dup key by the publication watcher.
